en: Black-and-white panoramic view of a lakeside town built on a hilly peninsula, with dense traditional houses, narrow streets, and surrounding hills. The water of a lake borders the town on the right. Along the bottom edge there is multilingual printed text identifying the view as a general view of Kastoria, and a small publisher credit. The card has a white border with a slightly scalloped edge.
